definition: Purchase events in the 365 days before the cutoff.
Net value (£) of all lines in the 365 days before the cutoff (trailing 12-month revenue).
Whole days from the first purchase day in the data to the cutoff date.
Whole days from the last purchase day to the cutoff date (1 = bought the day before).
Days between the last two purchase days in the last 365 days (365 if only one purchase day).
Mean days between consecutive purchase days in the last 365 days (365 if only one purchase day).
Net value (£) of all lines in the 180 days before the cutoff.
recency_days / avg_gap_days (above 1: already waiting longer than the usual gap).
Value returned / value bought in the last 365 days; same-day full cancellations count on neither side. Can exceed 1 when earlier purchases are returned.
1 if the customer bought in the November or December inside the last 365 days.
latest_gap_days / avg_gap_days (above 1: the last gap was longer than usual).
Purchase events in the 180 days before the cutoff.
1 if the country on the customer's latest line before the cutoff is the United Kingdom.
Value (£) of purchase events in the last 365 days divided by their number.
Net value (£) in the last 90 days minus net value in the 90 days before them.
Net value (£) of all lines, purchases minus returns, in the 90 days before the cutoff.
Distinct stock codes (upper-cased, stripped) in purchase events in the last 365 days.
Purchase events in the 90 days before the cutoff.
1 if the first purchase is in the first data month (Dec 2009): tenure is a lower bound.
1 if the customer bought on only one day in the last 365 days (gap features then use fill values).
Purchase events in the last 90 days minus those in the 90 days before them.
